tasks.target: 酸枣仁 origin, all five labels present in training and test

independence: Require actual procurement/preparation/measurement evidence. Renaming, scans or repeated pellets do not create new independent batches.

example_sampling_structure.roles: first two independently documented lots development; third untouched final-test lot; every class in every role
example_sampling_structure.scope: Illustrative operational design, not a powered or sufficient batch count; final batch Support use defines adaptation evaluation, not an untouched zero-shot endpoint

source_freeze.default_model: alpha612 SNV(ddof=1) StandardScaler RBF-SVM C10 gamma=scale balanced
source_freeze.selection: Source-only inner validation; retain all prespecified arms; never select on Query

target_role_freeze.label_stratification: uses true labels to satisfy per-class quota; log every screened label and costs including discarded candidates
target_role_freeze.query_access: isolated evaluation only, after prediction artifact sealed; no cross-sample statistics, selection, thresholds, early stop, fallback or method choice
target_role_freeze.transductive: Any Query-unlabeled distribution use requires separately named protocol and is forbidden in this one

methods.gamma: scale recomputed on fitted representation; B2F02 full-pipeline endpoint

methods.labels: Source labels only; Support true label values excluded
methods.basis: B3G02; class-stratified Support sampling remains label-informed

methods.labels: Source true; Support mapped to next class modulo frozen class order
methods.basis: B3G02 artificial negative control, not a finding of mislabeled originals

class_weight: balanced inherited B1 model; document realized class effective C; no silent switch to B5I02 None

exact_inherited_definition_fragments.B1_source_model: alpha612 SNV(ddof=1) StandardScaler RBF-SVM C10 gamma=scale balanced

B2_F02.reuse: refit_scaler/recomputed_gamma is the saved original full-pipeline model

B3_G02.scaler: fit Source+Support spectra in all adaptation arms
arms: Source-only labels with unlabeled Support statistics
Source+Support with Support-only class-cyclic copied labels
B3_G02.unlabeled_scope: Support pool was originally class-stratified; this arm does not fit Support label values

B4_H01.coordinates: frozen Source scaler and numeric gamma
B4_H01.selection: derived loss-mass interventions, no Query-based C tuning

B5_I01.scope: selection uses outer Source only; outer Support/Query excluded
B5_I01.choice: maximum mean inner validation Macro-F1 per K; round12 ties prefer identity,bias,mean_anchor,full_refit
B5_I01.outer_application: choose first, then reuse exact saved outer candidate endpoint
B5_I01.limitation: smaller Source-only inner problems may not transport to target Support domain

B5_I02.ranking_inputs: candidate spectra in frozen Source coordinates, Source scores and opaque hash keys; no candidate labels/Query
B5_I02.ranking: nested label-blind order; diversity is max-min coverage anchored by the Source centroid; class counts revealed after all orders fixed
B5_I02.full_refit: C10, Source-frozen scaler/gamma, class_weight None to hold per-point C fixed
B5_I02.guarded_mean_anchor: sum-loss lambda=number selected; Identity fallback if any Support class missing
B5_I02.reuse: complete/canonical historical subsets and repeated canonical ordered-ID objectives do not refit
B5_I02.scope: candidate pool was historically class-stratified; only within-pool ranking is label-blind

uncertainty: Keep physical specimens nested in actual batches; report per-batch results. Repeated Support draws do not increase Query specimen/batch N. At currently one known batch/source, between-batch variance is not identifiable.
acceptance_before_training: all metadata required fields populated from evidence
actual lots present in Source and target for every class
paired reference/grid/unit audits passed for intended merge
Query inaccessible to fitting and selection
new training explicitly enabled in a new authorization
entry_point_effect: metadata validation only; never fits or enables a model
